notes: Partition verified: 36 source and 54 target IDs each used exactly once, with one `added` unit.
The italic *they* is `added` — the clause is verbless and writes no subject, and rule 20 hands the construction only the copula.

*were* is left on the nominal predicate חִתִּית. The competing reading puts it on בְּ under rule 49, since in the Hebrew the prepositional phrase בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים is the predicate and חִתִּית גִּבּוֹרִים the subject; I kept the accepted reading because the ASV has recast the clause so that the source nominal is what the English copula predicates, while rule 49's settled corpus concerns clauses the ASV leaves prepositionally predicated.
